title: Jamaican Jerk Cottage Flatbread
description: A twist on traditional flatbread, this Jamaican Jerk Cottage Flatbread combines the flavors of the Caribbean with creamy cottage cheese.
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cottage cheese and Jamaican Jerk seasoning. Mix well.
Place flatbreads on a baking sheet.
Spoon cottage cheese mixture onto flatbreads, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Top with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until flatbreads are crispy and cheese is lightly browned.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
